question: On which specific days are early post-death śrāddha rites indicated?
premises: Specific days after death are ritually marked.
The fourth and fifth days are mentioned.
The nine-day and eleven-day periods are also indicated.
inference: Early śrāddha observances are indicated on the fourth, fifth, ninth, and eleventh days.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic scope of navāha with ekādaśāhayoḥ is compressed in the verse.
plain_english: On the fourth and fifth days, and in the nine-day and eleven-day periods.
